text:
Lina: Quick FYI — we are GAing FastPath Streaming (v1.0) for Hosted API today. Low-latency, short-turn streaming optimized for tool-calls and mobile use cases. Opt-in rollout via Console starting now. :tada:

Tom: Nice! is this the one that reduces TTFB for short prompts?

Lina: Yep. FastPath targets median TTFB improvements ~40% for <128-token responses. Also includes new backpressure knobs and low-cost packetized billing.

Maria: Ops heads-up — there will be a short canary window for internal clusters. I added an SLO checklist to the runbook.

Lina: Thanks @Maria — canaries in us-west-2 first, then global after 48h if metrics look good.

Alex: Docs / migration notes? Any SDK changes our support team should prep for?

Lina: Docs live: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/fastpath
Lina: Migration highlights: new endpoint name `/v1/fastpath/stream` and param `packet_size` (default 32). JS/Go SDKs have patch releases out.

Tom: Example curl?

Lina: Sure — short example:

Lina: ```bash
Lina: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Lina:   -d '{"model":"fp-light-1","packet_size":32,"tool_calls":true}' \
Lina:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/fastpath/stream
Lina: ```

Maria: Deploy bot reports: deploy-bot: FastPath rollout triggered for canary cluster (deploy/fastpath-v1).

deploy-bot: deploy/fastpath-v1: started at 2700012355, canary replica=3.

Tom: Any deprecation we should announce?

Lina: Yes — `realtime-lite` will be deprecated in 90 days. We will auto-route existing calls to FastPath only if customers opt in; otherwise we'll maintain compatibility for 60 days then start soft redirects. Full deprecation plan in docs.

Alex: I'll update the support playbooks and post a short training thread for CS.

Maria: Monitoring items: adding latency P95 dashboards, packet drop alerts, and canary health synthetic. I added the dashboards to the FastPath folder.

Lina: Town hall tomorrow 11am PT with product + eng + ops for rollout Q&A. RSVP in calendar.

Tom: One last question — are there new limits?

Lina: FastPath defaults: 20 rps per key for streaming calls, max packet_size 128, token-per-packet accounting. Customers can request higher quotas via console.

Alex: Copy that. I'll surface quota requests to growth.

deploy-bot: deploy/fastpath-v1: canary health=ok (2700012450). Rolling to region-us-east-1 next.

Lina: Thanks everyone — keep issues in #eng-runtime and tag me for escalations. :rocket:
